intent: Reproduce the vendor Form preset "Fractal Lines" (Lines); reference thumbnail: /Users/renzhongyi/Documents/AE_plugins_proj/recipe-harness/mining/thumbs/TC14/Form/Lines/Fractal Lines.png

iterations.critique: The render has the core preset language: luminous magenta/pink diagonal particle strings on black, with fine secondary strands and some fractal breakup. However, it reads more as a set of broad, nearly parallel light bars than a controlled fractal-line field. The composition is very uneven across time: frame 1 is mostly empty black with a few isolated streak groups, while frame 4 becomes heavily packed and clips into a very bright central-right mass. The motion between frames is therefore an excessive lateral sweep/repopulation rather than a more consistently distributed evolving fractal texture.

The render retains the intended black-and-magenta Form string aesthetic, and motion from t1 to t4 is now relatively stable rather than the severe repopulation seen previously. However, the image is still dominated by long, smooth, evenly spaced parallel bars. It reads as a cropped diagonal line grid, not a dense fractal-line field: the visible size modulation is too subtle, the strands have little internal variation, and several thick foreground strings are visually overpowering. The lower-edge spike groups also create an accidental clipped look rather than an evenly distributed fractal texture.

The black background and hot magenta Form-string palette are on target, and the two frames show a reasonably continuous evolving field rather than the severe empty-to-overpacked jump seen earlier. However, both frames still read primarily as long, smooth, uniformly angled streaks with repeated tapered capsules. The large bright strings dominate the image, especially at left in t1 and right/center in t4, while much of the frame remains empty black. There is very little visible fine-scale branching, turbulent fragmentation, or layered fractal detail, so it does not yet resemble the dense, intricate Fractal Lines preset.

The black background and magenta line color match the intended preset family, but the result is substantially less fractal than the reference intent. The frame is dominated by a sparse set of extremely long, smooth, nearly parallel diagonal streaks, including several clipped and overbright foreground bands at the far left. Most of the image is empty black, with almost no branching, granular breakup, or layered fine-line detail. The field reads as a simple diagonal line array rather than an intricate turbulent fractal-line texture.

The magenta-on-black palette remains related to the Form preset family, but this frame is now an extreme close-up of soft, smooth, parallel diagonal bands. It lacks the reference preset's intricate, distributed fractal-string texture: there is virtually no visible branching, turbulent breakup, or fine layered line structure. The far-left bands are heavily blown out and the field has little black-space separation, so it reads as blurred light streaks rather than Fractal Lines.
